title: Enabled AWS regions
description: Lists AWS regions with their opt-in status; exclude not-opted-in regions from sweeps.

params.name: seed_region
params.description: Routing region for the describe-regions call; any enabled region works

template: SELECT regionName, optInStatus FROM aws.ec2_native.regions WHERE region = '{{seed_region}}';
notes: region is a routing parameter, not a filter. Exclude rows with optInStatus = 'not-opted-in' before fanning out with WHERE region IN (...).
